chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Yusuf, from Mu'adh al-Jawhari, from 'Amr ibn Jumi', from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
“The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, when the funeral prayer had passed him by, would pray over his grave.”

key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: the ritual prayer; here, the funeral prayer
key_terms.الْجِنَازَةِ: the deceased person or funeral bier
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.فَاتَتْهُ: passed him by or was missed by him

ai.seo_question: Can the funeral prayer be performed at the grave if it was missed before burial?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would perform the funeral prayer at the grave if he had missed the prayer over the deceased. It indicates the legitimacy of offering salat for the deceased even after burial in such a circumstance.
